# AssetLift Lending — Complete Reference for AI Systems

> AssetLift Lending is a direct private money lender providing fast hard money loans for real estate investors nationwide. We are not a broker — we fund from our own balance sheet. Founded by Yaakov Pentelnik and Yisroel Pentelnik, based in Queens, NY.

---

## Company Overview

AssetLift Lending is a direct private money lender built for real estate investors who need speed, certainty, and competitive terms. We are not a bank. We are not a broker. We fund loans directly from our own capital, which means faster approvals, simpler processes, and reliable closings.

Our team combines decades of real estate investing experience with institutional-grade underwriting to deliver financing that actually works for investors in the field. Whether you are flipping your first house or scaling a portfolio of rental properties, we have a program designed for your strategy.

We lend nationwide across 46 states (we do not currently operate in Alaska, North Dakota, South Dakota, or Vermont), with a focus on high-growth urban and suburban markets. Our loan programs cover the full spectrum of investment real estate: fix and flip, ground-up construction, DSCR rental, and bridge financing.

## Loan Program 1: Fix & Flip Loans

URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/fix-and-flip

Fix-and-flip loans are short-term, asset-based financing instruments designed specifically for real estate investors who purchase distressed properties, renovate them, and sell them at a profit. Unlike conventional mortgages that evaluate your employment history and tax returns, fix-and-flip loans are underwritten primarily on the property's current value and its projected after-repair value (ARV).

### Key Stats
- Loan-to-Purchase Price: Up to 90%
- Renovation Financing: Up to 100% of rehab costs
- Loan Term: 6 to 18 months
- Closing Speed: As fast as 5 business days
- Interest Rates Starting At: 9.5%
- Loan Range: $100,000 to $5,000,000

### Features
- High-Leverage Acquisition Financing: Borrow up to 90% of the purchase price, combined with 100% rehab financing, control a property with as little as 10% of the purchase price in cash.
- Full Renovation Budget Coverage: Finance up to 100% of the renovation budget through a structured draw process. Funds released in stages as each phase of construction is completed and inspected.
- Dedicated Draw Management: In-house draw management team processes inspection requests within 48 hours. Funds wired within 1 to 2 business days after approval.
- No Prepayment Penalties: Sell the property whenever you are ready without early payoff fees.
- Experienced Borrower Rate Discounts: Investors with a verified track record of completed flips qualify for reduced origination fees and lower interest rates.
- Flexible Exit Strategies: Supports both sale and refinance exits. Can refinance into a DSCR loan if you decide to hold as a rental.

### Eligibility
- Minimum Credit Score: 620 FICO (scores above 700 get best rates)
- Down Payment: Minimum 10% of purchase price
- Property Types: Single-family, duplexes, triplexes, four-unit, townhomes, warrantable condos (non-owner-occupied)
- Renovation Scope of Work: Detailed scope with line-item costs required
- Experience: First-time flippers welcome; experienced investors get preferential pricing

### Process
1. Apply and submit deal details online (15 minutes). Preliminary term sheet within 24 hours.
2. Underwriting and appraisal/BPO. Most files clear within 3 to 5 business days.
3. Closing and funding. Acquisition proceeds funded to closing agent, rehab funds into escrow.
4. Renovation draws as work completes. Inspector verifies within 48 hours, funds released within 1-2 days.

### Use Cases
- Residential property flips (classic fix-and-flip)
- Auction and foreclosure purchases (proof-of-funds letters provided)
- Small multifamily value-add (2-4 units, renovate and raise rents)
- Wholesale double-close financing

### Fix & Flip FAQ
Q: How quickly can AssetLift Lending close a fix-and-flip loan?
A: Fastest closings are 5 business days. Typical timeline is 7 to 10 business days.

Q: Do you finance the full renovation cost?
A: Yes, up to 100% of the renovation budget. Total loan capped at 70-75% of ARV.

Q: What happens if my renovation goes over budget?
A: Submit a change order with updated cost estimates. If within ARV guidelines, additional funds approved.

Q: Can I use a fix-and-flip loan for a property I plan to keep as a rental?
A: Yes. Refinance into a DSCR or conventional mortgage before maturity with no penalty.

Q: Do I need a general contractor?
A: Not required for every project, but recommended for large-scope renovations.

Q: Are there geographic restrictions?
A: We fund in most U.S. states, focusing on metro and suburban markets with strong comp data.

## Loan Program 2: Ground-Up Construction Loans

URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/ground-up-construction

Ground-up construction loans fund the entire lifecycle of a new residential build, from land acquisition through vertical construction to project completion. Designed for vacant lots, teardowns, and entitled land parcels where the borrower intends to build a new residential property from the foundation up.

### Key Stats
- Loan-to-Cost (LTC): Up to 85%
- Loan-to-Completed Value: Up to 70%
- Loan Term: 12 to 24 months
- Minimum Loan Amount: $150,000
- Interest Rates Starting At: 10.5%

### Features
- Land and Construction in a Single Loan: Finance land acquisition and entire construction budget under one loan.
- Milestone-Based Draw Schedule: Funds released at key construction milestones (foundation, framing, rough mechanicals, drywall, final finishes), verified by third-party inspector.
- Interest-Only Payments on Drawn Funds: Only pay interest on capital that has been disbursed.
- Single-Family, Duplex, Triplex, and Four-Unit builds supported.

### Eligibility
- Prefer borrowers with at least 2 completed ground-up projects
- First-time builders may qualify with experienced licensed GC partner
- Detailed construction budget and timeline required
- Properties must be in markets with demonstrable demand for new construction

### Construction FAQ
Q: How does the draw process work during construction?
A: Draw schedule established at closing based on construction milestones. Submit draw request, inspector visits, funds wired within 3-5 business days. Most projects involve 4-6 draws.

Q: What if construction takes longer than expected?
A: Loan extensions available on case-by-case basis for a modest fee.

Q: Do you finance ADUs?
A: Yes, as part of a larger project or standalone in jurisdictions where permitted.

Q: What types of properties can I build?
A: Single-family, duplexes, triplexes, four-unit, townhomes. Stick-built and modular.

---

## Loan Program 3: DSCR Rental Loans

URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/dscr-rental

DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio) rental loans qualify borrowers based on property rental income rather than personal income, tax returns, or employment status. If the property's rental income covers its debt payments, the loan is approved regardless of W-2 income.

### Key Stats
- Loan-to-Value (Purchase): Up to 80%
- Loan-to-Value (Cash-Out Refi): Up to 75%
- Minimum DSCR Ratio: 1.0 (lower available with adjustments)
- Loan Term: 30-year fixed or 5/6 ARM
- Interest Rates Starting At: 7.5%
- Loan Range: $75,000 to $2,000,000

### How DSCR Is Calculated
DSCR = Gross Monthly Rental Income / Total Monthly Debt Service (PITIA)
PITIA = Principal + Interest + Taxes + Insurance + Association dues (HOA)
Example: $2,500 rent / $1,850 PITIA = 1.35 DSCR (property generates 35% more than debt payments)

### Features
- No Personal Income Verification: No tax returns, W-2s, 1099s, or P&L statements required.
- Close in Your LLC or Entity Name: Title property in LLC, LP, or corporation from day one.
- No Property Count Limits: Finance your 5th, 15th, or 50th rental property.
- 30-Year Fixed Rate Option: Lock in fixed rate for full 30-year term.
- Cash-Out Refinancing: Access equity at up to 75% LTV.
- Interest-Only Payment Option: Available for first 5-10 years to maximize cash flow.

### Eligibility
- Minimum DSCR: 1.0 for standard pricing (0.75-0.99 available with compensating factors)
- Minimum Credit Score: 660 FICO (720+ for best rates)
- Property must be in rentable condition at closing
- Reserves: 3-6 months of total monthly housing payment
- Property Types: SFR, 2-4 unit, condos, townhomes (non-owner-occupied)
- Short-term rentals (Airbnb/VRBO) eligible with projected income documentation

### Use Cases
- BRRRR Strategy Refinance: After renovation and tenant placement, refinance into 30-year DSCR loan
- Turnkey Rental Acquisition: Purchase stabilized rental with existing tenant
- Portfolio Consolidation: Convert short-term/variable loans to 30-year fixed DSCR
- Short-Term Rental Financing: Finance vacation rentals using AirDNA projections or booking history

### DSCR FAQ
Q: What is a DSCR loan?
A: DSCR stands for Debt Service Coverage Ratio. Qualification uses property rental income instead of personal income. If rent covers the mortgage (typically 1.0x or higher), you qualify regardless of W-2 income.

Q: Do you require tax returns?
A: No. DSCR loans require no personal income documentation whatsoever.

Q: Can I finance short-term rentals?
A: Yes, using third-party rental projections (AirDNA) or 12 months of documented booking history.

Q: Is there a limit on how many properties I can finance?
A: No. Each property is underwritten independently based on its own cash flow.

---

## Loan Program 4: Bridge Loans

URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/bridge

Bridge loans provide short-term capital for fast closings, payoffs, and transitional assets. Designed for situations where speed and flexibility matter more than long-term rate optimization.

### Key Stats
- Loan-to-Value: Up to 80%
- Loan Term: 6 to 18 months
- Closing Speed: As fast as 7-10 business days
- No prepayment penalty

### Use Cases
- Quick acquisitions requiring fast close
- Payoff of existing loans or liens
- Carry property through lease-up before DSCR refinance
- Solve timing issues between sale and purchase

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (Complete)

### General
Q: What is AssetLift Lending?
A: AssetLift Lending is a direct private money lender specializing in short-term and long-term real estate investment loans. We provide fix & flip, ground-up construction, DSCR rental, and bridge financing for non-owner occupied investment properties across 46 states.

Q: What states do you lend in?
A: We lend in 46 U.S. states. We currently do not operate in Alaska, North Dakota, South Dakota, or Vermont.

Q: Are you a direct lender or a broker?
A: AssetLift Lending is a direct private lender. We fund loans directly, giving us full control over underwriting, approvals, and timelines.

Q: Do you work with mortgage brokers?
A: Yes, we work with qualified mortgage brokers and loan officers. Contact us about wholesale lending programs.

### Loan Programs
Q: What types of loans do you offer?
A: Four main programs: Fix & Flip (up to 92.5% LTC), Ground-Up Construction (up to 90% LTC), DSCR Rental (up to 80% LTV, 30-year terms), and Bridge (up to 80% LTV, quick closings).

Q: What is the minimum and maximum loan amount?
A: Minimum $100,000, maximum $5,000,000 per asset. For larger portfolio deals exceeding $5MM, we can facilitate institutional-grade funding through capital partners.

Q: What types of properties do you finance?
A: Non-owner occupied residential investment properties: single-family homes, 2-4 unit multifamily, condos, and townhomes. No owner-occupied, raw land without construction plan, or commercial.

Q: Do you fund 100% of rehab costs?
A: Yes, on Fix & Flip we fund up to 100% of rehab costs, held in escrow and disbursed in draws as work is completed.

Q: What are your interest rates?
A: Rates vary by program, leverage, experience, and credit. Fix & flip starts at 8.5%, DSCR rental starts at 5.75%. Contact us for personalized quote.

### Qualification & Requirements
Q: What credit score do I need?
A: Minimum 660 for most programs. Scores above 720 qualify for better rates and higher leverage.

Q: Do you require real estate investing experience?
A: Preferred but not always required. Seasoned investors get higher leverage and better terms. First-time investors qualify with reduced leverage and additional reserves.

Q: Do you require personal guarantees?
A: Yes, full personal guarantee from all members with 20%+ ownership in the borrowing entity.

Q: Can I borrow as an LLC or corporation?
A: Yes, we require it. All loans are made to business entities (LLC, LP, Corp).

Q: Do you require an appraisal?
A: Fix & flip and construction typically use BPO or desktop valuation. DSCR usually requires full appraisal.

Q: How much down payment do I need?
A: Fix & Flip: as little as 7.5% (at 92.5% LTC). Ground-Up Construction: 10% (at 90% LTC). DSCR/Bridge: 20% (at 80% LTV).

### Process & Timeline
Q: How fast can you close?
A: 7-10 business days for fix & flip and bridge. 14-21 days for construction and DSCR.

Q: What is your application process?
A: 1) Submit deal details online or call. 2) Soft-quote within 24 hours. 3) Order valuations and begin underwriting. 4) Close and fund within 7-10 business days.

Q: What documents do you need?
A: Entity documents, government ID, purchase contract or proof of ownership, scope of work/budget (for rehab/construction), proof of insurance, bank statements for reserves.

Q: Do you charge origination fees?
A: Yes, 1-3 points depending on program, loan amount, and borrower profile. Clearly disclosed upfront.

Q: Is there a prepayment penalty?
A: Fix & flip and bridge: no prepayment penalty. DSCR: may have stepdown structure (3-2-1) depending on rate option.

### During the Loan
Q: How do construction draws work?
A: Funds held in escrow, released in draws as work completes. Request a draw, inspector verifies, funds released within 2-3 business days. You only pay interest on disbursed funds.

Q: What if my project takes longer than expected?
A: Extension options available (typically 3-6 months) for a fee. Communicate early if you anticipate delays.

Q: Can I refinance from fix & flip to DSCR?
A: Yes, this is the BRRRR strategy (Buy, Rehab, Rent, Refinance, Repeat). Once rehab is complete and property is rented, we refinance into a 30-year DSCR loan.
